name: Pair G40 ground: G40-AX3G and G40-AX35, one timeline
notes: Both radios keyed from this ground station on one network, starting together on Run mission: downlink, G40-AX3G keys each comm waveform for 13 s and G40-AX35 (g40) decodes on TRx1A; then uplink, G40-AX35 keys its waveforms on TRx1B at 30 dB and G40-AX3G decodes on TRx1A through the payload RX chain, RX attenuator 40 dB; then G40-AX35 holds one decode step for every area message while the air radio's location tasks key along the route (arm the triggers, feed on). The areas are typed in the step editor once the route is known. Sections from Run mission: downlink 00:00:05 to 00:04:29 (12 waveforms), uplink from 00:05:24 (7 waveforms), range gate decode from 00:08:28 for 60 min.

authorization.note: bench: HPA output on the coupler and load, no antenna, unless the card says otherwise
